summary.text: Jenny Graham represents the 6th Legislative District in the Washington House of Representatives. Her official page lists her as Ranking Member of the Community Safety Committee, and she also serves on the Civil Rights & Judiciary and Postsecondary Education & Workforce committees.

paragraphs.text: Virginia "Jenny" Graham graduated from Thomas Jefferson High School in 1983 and has been a licensed Professional Cosmetologist and Esthetician since 1984, according to her official page.
It says she is a former small business owner and a veteran who served in the Army Reserve in the transportation field.

The page describes her as a victims' advocate and says that in 2011 she began working with legislators, prosecutors, law enforcement and other survivors to change statute-of-limitations laws, with legislation signed by Gov. Inslee in 2014.
It lists special committee service on the Joint Committee on Veterans' and Military Affairs and the Public Records Exemption Accountability Committee.
